services.desc: Imagine staring up at the starry sky, rocking with the waves while sipping champagne with your friends and family. The Patriotic music starts and the colorful bursts of fireworks explode in the sky right before your eyes. As each song plays the fireworks get more and more spectacular until the finale blows you away. There truly is no better way to experience fireworks than floating on a boat surrounded by the beautiful blue water of Lake Tahoe. Standing size bathroom (head), cooler, Bluetooth stereo, and small fridge available for your use.
